author: Platypus15
quote: Absolutely love this game, once I started I couldn't stop, its the perfect mix of mysterious beautiful, exciting, relaxing, and most of all it is so much fun, the puzzles are just right. And everything is done perfect. I haven't had a single complaint about anything.  Who knew that playing as a cat would Absolutely levitate the playing experience. . I highly recommend this game to anyone and everyone.  I hope more people play it and have just as much as a good time as I did. Absolutely amazing game design. I hope there are more like this.
